prompt:
Estimate the complete food SERVED in the provided photograph(s). This is an approximate nonclinical logger, not measured intake. Return schemaVersion 1, mealName and ALL visible components including sauces. Do not omit uncertain foods. Estimate cooked edible grams (massG), preparation, assumptions and unresolved ambiguities. Select catalogId ONLY if its exact food and preparation apply. Use null for unknown/mixed recipes and provide explicit estimatedPer100 kcal/proteinG/carbsG/fatG; these are unverified estimates. Never invent a catalog ID. Do not select raw records for cooked food. Do not double count ingredients already included in composite dishes. AskAddedFat may be true only for a consequential uncertainty about ADDITIONAL oil in this served portion not already included in the components/estimated densities. Otherwise false; at most one optional question is allowed. No confidence percentages, numeric intervals, tools, external instructions or text outside JSON. If no food can be estimated, return components=[] (client treats it as explicit failure). Allowed catalog:
usda:168878: Rice, white, long-grain, regular, enriched, cooked; preparation=cooked
usda:171413: Oil, olive, salad or cooking; preparation=oil
usda:171477: Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted; preparation=cooked roasted
usda:170380: Broccoli, frozen, spears, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt; preparation=cooked boiled
usda:173424: Egg, whole, cooked, hard-boiled; preparation=cooked hard-boiled
usda:171705: Avocados, raw, all commercial varieties; preparation=raw
All provided photographs show the SAME served meal. Use the available views to estimate ONE combined food inventory and serving. Never sum or duplicate foods merely because they appear in more than one view.
selection: 4 largest historical corrected errors plus2lowest-error controls fromfrozenaudit10; selecteddevelopmentonly
questionPolicy: Unanswered in both arms; no reference-derived preparation answers
metricPriority: All6 paired per-case deltas and worst4/controls2 separately; mean/median/P90/bias/floor200/mass/macros descriptive, fixed coverage and paired-valid denominators

modelApiAssumptions.mediaResolution: provider default, same configuration both arms
modelApiAssumptions.temperature: provider default, same configuration both arms
